WHAT YOU'LL DO

Our financial models have two audiences. Internally, they guide how we plan, hire, and raise capital. Externally, they help a large veterinary network decide whether to partner with us, and the EBITDA lift model and pricing proposal are often what a network's CFO evaluates before signing. You will spend about 70% of your time on FP&A and about 30% on customer-facing modeling. The work rewards people who ask why a number is what it is, can turn a vague question into a structured analysis, and care whether the reader understands the answer. After a year, you will own the operating model, the board package, and the standard enterprise proposal model, and the sales team will bring you into late-stage deals as a matter of course.

 - Build investor-ready models, scenario analyses, and data room materials during fundraising.

 - Build and maintain management reporting and self-service dashboards in Sigma.

 - Model revenue recognition for enterprise customers under ASC 606, including allocation, consumption-based recognition, straight-line amortization, and breakage.

 - Join customer calls when a CFO or procurement team wants to test assumptions on incrementality and ROI.

 - Analyze performance across our live hospitals, including spend lift, visit frequency, cancellations, breakage, and payment capture.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 - You have 4 or more years in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or finance at a SaaS or healthcare company.

 About Flosum 
 Flosum is a Salesforce-native platform company delivering enterprise-grade DevOps, data protection, and security solutions to some of the world's largest organizations. We serve enterprise customers across technology, energy, financial services, healthcare, and federal government. Flosum is a growth-stage company operating with the intensity and speed of a startup backed by the discipline of a mature operator.
 The Role 
 We're hiring a SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst who will own the measurement layer of our entire business. You will be the person who knows every number — ARR, net retention, expansion, churn, pipeline conversion, cost of acquisition, gross margin by product line, services margin, cash flow, and everything in between. You'll work across Salesforce (our CRM and billing system of record) and QuickBooks (our financial system) to build a unified, always-current picture of company performance.
 This is not a reporting role. This is an analytical role where you connect revenue operations data to financial outcomes and surface the insights that drive decisions at the CEO level.
 What You'll Own 
 You will build and maintain our SaaS metrics infrastructure — ARR waterfall, cohort retention analysis, revenue recognition schedules, deferred revenue tracking, and unit economics by segment. You will reconcile Salesforce bookings data against QuickBooks revenue entries and ensure we have a single source of truth across both systems. You will produce monthly and quarterly financial and revenue packages for leadership, including variance analysis against plan. You will model scenarios for pricing changes, product bundling, geographic expansion, and headcount investment. You will monitor pipeline health and translate pipeline data into revenue forecasts with documented assumptions. You will own the data integrity between our CRM and accounting systems, flagging discrepancies before they compound. You will support board-level and investor-level reporting with clean, defensible metrics.
 Requirements 
 What We're Looking For 
 You have three-plus years of experience in SaaS financial analysis, revenue operations, or FP&A at a B2B software company. You are deeply proficient in Salesforce — not as a user, but as someone who understands opportunity objects, product schedules, contract structures, and reporting at a data level. You are equally proficient in QuickBooks Online, including chart of accounts design, revenue categorization, journal entries, and reconciliation workflows. You understand ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and can apply them to a multi-product SaaS business with annual and multi-year contracts. You can build financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets — not from templates, from logic. You think in terms of cohorts, not just totals. You understand the difference between bookings, billings, and revenue, and you can explain why each matters. You are precise, skeptical of your own numbers, and obsessive about data integrity.

Flosum is building the definitive platform for Salesforce lifecycle management, and we need someone who can measure every dimension of that growth with precision.

description:
Footprint is the agentic platform that learns your compliance program and runs it end to end.


Compliance teams at banks and fintechs are drowning in financial crimes investigations. Transaction volumes are surging, regulators keep raising the bar, and the work still runs on manual review queues stitched together from legacy vendors. Percy, our agentic system, learns each team's procedures and makes the same calls their analysts would: clearing false positives, escalating real risk, writing the case narrative, and documenting every decision for audit. It cuts review workloads by 70%+.


The harder problem is underneath. Every investigation is grounded in the data sources compliance teams already trust, and every case commits to an organizational memory that compounds — so a pattern one analyst caught in March surfaces automatically in October, across KYC, EDD, sanctions, and monitoring. Whether the team is five analysts or 500, they share one brain. Every memory carries provenance. Agents propose; humans approve. That's four years of identity infrastructure sitting under the agent, and it's the part nobody can bolt on later.


We're backed by QED, Index, and Box Group, and trusted by FDIC- and OCC-regulated banks plus fintechs like Bilt, Nuvei, and MoonPay. We 5x'd revenue last year. The team is small, senior, and ships fast.





THE ROLE

Footprint's AI agent, Percy, investigates financial crime for the largest fintechs and financial institutions. Percy is only as good as the data behind it, and the best data isn't easily accessible. Somebody has to find those sources, figure out which vendors are real and which are noise, negotiate the terms, and get signed agreements to engineering. That's the biggest piece of this job, and we think it's some of the highest-leverage work at the company, because proprietary data is one of the few durable advantages left in AI.



You'll also own the operations behind our go-to-market. Sales and marketing have grown faster than the systems behind them, and today it takes manual work to answer basic questions about the business. You'd build the tooling and reporting that fixes that.



Finance operations are part of the job too, from vendor negotiations to headcount planning and budgeting as we grow.



Beyond that, you'll have real freedom to go after whatever you believe is the most important problem at Footprint. Pricing strategy, a new market, a partnership worth evaluating. WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Customer Experience runs on data — but right now, that data lives in too many places, speaks too many languages, and reaches the wrong people too late. This role exists to fix that.

As Harvey's first Support Operations Data Analyst, you'll own the analytics function for the Customer Experience org. You'll build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and feedback loops that tell us whether we're hitting our north stars — cSAT, TTR, QA scores, escalation rates — and surface the signal underneath the numbers so we can act on it. You'll sit within the Support Operations team, reporting to the Support Operations Manager, and work closely with Customer Experience leadership and Harvey's central data team to ensure the org is equipped with the right instrumentation as we scale.

This is a solo role. You won't have a team beneath you. You will need to be fluent enough in support analytics to hold the function independently, confident enough to push back on how metrics are framed, and fast enough to operate at Harvey's pace.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own recurring reporting for Customer Experience — weekly, monthly, and QBR-ready — tailored to ops, leadership, and cross-functional audiences

 - Translate support data into clear narratives: what's happening, why, and what to do about it

 - Track and maintain north star metrics: cSAT, TTR by tier, QA scores, bug escalation rate to EPD, and First Response Time

 - Build and maintain self-serve dashboards that give the ops team and leadership real-time visibility into support performance

 - Partner with Support Systems to ensure Zendesk is instrumented to capture the data we need

 - Work with Harvey's central data team to connect support data to broader product and customer data sources

 - Identify and close data collection gaps — if we can't measure it, help define how we should

 - Design feedback loops that connect support signals to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success

 - Quantify the operational cost of product bugs, feature gaps, and onboarding failures

 - Contribute to QA analytics as the QA program matures

 - Track ticket deflection, AI/chatbot performance, and self-service effectiveness

 - Measure the impact of AI-driven support — containment rate, escalation rate from AI interactions, resolution quality — and surface findings that drive how we tune and invest in those tools

 - Support ad hoc analytical requests from the Support Operations Manager, Customer Experience leadership, and senior stakeholders

 


WHAT YOU HAVE

Required

 - 3–5 years of experience in analytics, with at least 2 years directly in support operations, customer success operations, or a closely adjacent function

 - Fluency in support platform data — you know how Zendesk (or equivalent) is structured, what data it produces, and what it doesn't
 - SQL proficiency — you can write complex queries against large datasets without hand-holding (CTEs, window functions, joins across schemas)
 - Dashboard experience — you've built and maintained operational dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Sigma, Omni, or equivalent
 - Reporting for multiple audiences — you know the difference between what a frontline manager needs and what a CFO needs, and you build accordingly
 - Strong data storytelling — you don't just present numbers, you write the narrative
 [...]  - Experience with Python for data manipulation or automation
 - Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tooling
 - Experience building or contributing to QA analytics programs
 - Background supporting enterprise SaaS or AI-native products
 - Experience working with Zendesk APIs or extracting data beyond standard reporting
Key Attributes
 - AI-native: you use AI tooling actively in your analytical workflows — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier
 - Pace: you move in hours and days, not weeks. You surface findings before anyone has to ask
 - Judgment: you know which metrics matter and which are vanity. You push back when framing is wrong
 - Clarity: your outputs are direct, jargon-free, and actionable. You write for the reader, not yourself
 - Ownership: you treat Customer Experience analytics as your problem to solve, not a ticket queue to process
COMPENSATION

The future of healthcare is here. Join us to shape the future of healthcare for patients and clinicians. BioIntelliSense is helping to decode human physiology and pioneer a new standard of proactive monitoring to improve healthcare outcomes and save lives.

Through our physiologic intelligence and AI-driven analytics, clinicians have access to vital sign trending and data-driven insights to enable earlier detection of patient health decline and proactive intervention for faster, safer care.
 
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________


We are hiring a high-potential early-career teammate to help drive commercial execution across remote monitoring programs, health system partnerships, and state-sponsored initiatives.
 
This role is for someone smart, hungry, organized, and genuinely AI-first. You do not need decades of experience, but you do need strong judgment, high ownership, and the ability to turn messy inputs into clear, useful output fast.
 
You will work across proposals, commercial analysis, internal coordination, follow-up, and day-to-day execution. Some days that may mean building a pricing model or cleaning up a proposal. Other days it may mean organizing moving pieces across stakeholders, writing a crisp recap, or using AI to accelerate work that would otherwise take hours.
 
This is not a pure sales role, and it is not a pure strategy role. It is a high-exposure execution role for someone who wants steep learning, meaningful responsibility, and the chance to grow quickly by working closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
 
What you'll do
 
Commercial execution and proposal support
Draft and improve external-facing proposals, scope summaries, rate card packages, and supporting materials
Turn calls, notes, and rough direction into clear outputs such as recap notes, follow-up emails, action trackers, and decision logs
Keep documents organized, current, and easy to navigate, with strong version control and clean source materials
Help prepare leadership for meetings, follow-ups, and fast-moving commercial discussions
 
Sizing, pricing, and business analysis
Build and maintain Excel or Google Sheets models that help size, price, and compare opportunities
Check assumptions, formulas, and outputs carefully to ensure they are sound and internally consistent
Pull together concise summaries that help leaders understand the opportunity, key decisions, and operational implications
Support lightweight analysis across pipeline, commercial models, and strategic priorities
 
Coordination and follow-through
Keep multiple workstreams moving across timelines, owners, dependencies, and next steps
Maintain a simple, reliable view of active opportunities, including status, next action, and priority
Produce clear weekly updates and meeting prep materials that help leaders make decisions quickly
Follow through without needing repeated reminders
 
AI-first ways of working
Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and similar platforms to accelerate drafting, synthesis, research support, and structured analysis
Build reusable prompts, templates, and workflows that improve speed, consistency, and quality
Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work and simplify how the team operates
Verify outputs carefully, especially anything numerical, customer-facing, or high-stakes

- 1 to 3 years of experience, or clear evidence that you are unusually high output and quick to learn
- Strong writing and synthesis skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally
- Comfort with spreadsheets and basic modeling logic
- High attention to detail and strong ownership mentality
- Natural curiosity about AI tools and enthusiasm for using them to work smarter and faster
- Ability to stay organized and reliable in a fast-moving environment
- Humility, coachability, and genuine appetite for growth
- Good judgment, positive attitude, and willingness to do the work behind the scenes that keeps things moving

Where we are today:

 - Last year we raised a $50M Series C, valuing Atticus at $450M.

 - We’ve kicked off our Injury vertical with a small but scrappy team working on the offering and GTM approach.


THE JOB

Our business is complex and multi-faceted: We play in an enormous space with huge barriers to entry, we have no direct competitors, and as a two-sided marketplace we have to coordinate multiple constituencies via a complex funnel with some parts that are all tech and others that are fully human. Every day we face new operating challenges that require someone to quickly gather data, make a decision, and execute.

So, in addition to software engineers, lawyers, and marketers, our team includes a bunch of ex-consultants (our CEO is a BCG alum and we’ve built a small BizOps org from BCG, Bain and McKinsey). To a level that’s unusual among our peer startups, we’re investing in building a top-tier Strategy & Business Operations team that oversees the core of our business and drives key projects, and we’re hiring several more consultants to join it.

This job mixes things in any good consultant’s comfort zone (devising strategy, managing and coordinating projects, gathering and analyzing data) with responsibilities unique to being an operator in a fast-growing tech company (user research, product development, growth marketing, venture finance). Typical projects you’d own:

 - Design, test, and ship a site experiment for our new Injury vertical to qualify and convert clients.

 - Find the gaps in our client service operations and lead the project that cuts our costs to serve each client by 25%.

 - Rebuild the model that predicts what each case is worth, and wire it into how we bid on ads and forecast the business.

 - Stand up and run a new QA function: build the tooling and interface, design the process, and train the team.

Required:

 - You were/are at a top consulting firm and thrived there.

 - You’ve led ambiguous projects end-to-end: framed the question, owned a complex model, made the call, and worked hand-in-hand with the client team to implement.

 - You’re excited to own our toughest modeling workstreams.

 - You’re a kind and thoughtful colleague who knows how to shape a great team culture, persuasively advocate for your ideas, and get buy-in from others.

 - You have a demonstrated commitment to doing good and helping people.

Bonus / Nice-to-Have:

 - You took on management ahead of tenure (e.g., EM at McKinsey, mini-PL at BCG, Manager at Bain).

 - You have experience with marketplace businesses or complex consumer services (insurance, fintech, medical, real estate, etc.).

 - You’ve done consumer-focused research or discovery work, or something else that makes you comfortable interviewing and empathizing with people from all walks of life.

We are strongly committed to building a diverse team. If you’re from a background that’s underrepresented in tech, we’d love to meet you

This is a rare opportunity to join a startup that has strong traction (substantial funding, well-respected backers, tremendous growth, and many happy customers) but is still small enough that you can have a huge impact and play a role in shaping our culture.

We’re a certified B Corporation tackling a critical social problem. Our mission to help people in need drives everything we do, and your work here will touch many lives.

LOCATION

Work remotely, and travel to LA (on the company dime) as needed to be with your colleagues – usually quarterly, plus offsites. title: Specialty Finance Trade Administrator
description:
The Specialty Finance Trade Administrator supports the end-to-end trade and transaction lifecycle for a portfolio primarily focused on structured private credit facilities and whole loan portfolios. The Trade Administrator acts as a central coordinator among Portfolio Managers, Traders, Deal Team Origination Members, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Prime Brokers, Custodians, Agent Banks, service providers, and Brokers to ensure trading and private deal activity is reflected accurately across systems and records.   
 Key Responsibilities   
- Support trading account and security master set-up activities   
- Validate completeness and accuracy of transaction booking across trading, operations, and finance—including public securities, private deal closings and post-close lifecycle events.   
- Coordinate trade administration activities for whole loan acquisitions, including loan onboarding, data validation, trade capture, allocation, funding coordination, documentation review, and settlement with originator platforms and internal stakeholders.   
- Engage with deal team on private asset transactions approaching close: capture deal economics, confirm system set-up, and ensure booking is complete and accurate   
- Coordinate with brokers (public) and agent banks/counterparties (private) on execution details, corrections, and documentation requirements.   
- Reconcile trade capture between OMS/EMS, broker confirms, matching platforms, and accounting books; ensure prompt correction of discrepancies.   
- Escalate fails risk and aged exceptions; coordinate remediation plans with internal and external counterparties.   
 Required Qualifications   
- Bachelor’s degree; Finance, Accounting, or Economics majors preferred.   
- 4 –7 + years of experience in trade administration, middle office, or fund operations, ideally supporting an investment desk.   
- Demonstrated exposure to trade support for public securities and/or private credit/specialty finance transactions.   
- Experience with coordinating complex private deal closes, including documentation tracking and interpretation, funding/wire coordination, and post-close lifecycle event processing.   
- Strong OMS/EMS proficiency and trade lifecycle knowledge across multiple asset classes.   
- Advanced Excel skills; comfort working with large datasets and building controls/reconciliations.   
- Experience with agent bank / loan administration platforms.   
- Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to coordinate effectively across wide range of stakeholders.   
- Highly organized with strong attention to detail and disciplined escalation practices.   
- Demonstrated ownership mindset and ability to perform in time-sensitive situations.   
- Commitment to a control-oriented, institutional operating culture.   
 Preferred Qualifications   
- CFA and/or CAIA   
- Familiarity with illiquid asset valuation and reconciliation nuances.   
- Experience working with fund administrators and/or shadow NAV validation processes.   
- Familiarity with Aladdin, Bloomberg, Arcesium, Snowflake/SQL.   
 Location: New York City; hybrid with a minimum of three days per week in office. 
Applicants must be authorized and have the right to work in the country where the role is located without the need for current or future sponsorship. 
 Compensation Details 
The salary range for this role is $110,000-$130,000. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in the job posting location. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, business sector, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, market benchmarking data, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. This job is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, which, along with base salary and retirement contributions, is part of our total comprehensive package. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, retirement, life insurance and other benefits to eligible employees. 
 Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, production, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.
 Neuberger is an equal opportunity employer. The Firm and its affiliates do not discriminate in employment because of race, creed, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship status or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations. title: Entry-Level Financial Advisor: Start your Career With Us
description:
About Us 
 WealthBridge Financial Group helps individuals, families, and business owners build, protect, and grow their wealth. We don’t do one-size-fits-all. Every strategy is personalized and forward-thinking, and it’s grounded in innovation, collaboration, and education. We aim to be the advisors clients trust for life, not just for one transaction.
 www.wealthbridgefg.com 
 The Opportunity 
 We’re growing, and we’re looking for driven, entrepreneurial people to join us as Financial Professionals in our Long Island offices in Garden City and Melville. You’ll sit across the table from clients, help them map out their financial future, and build a practice that’s truly yours. You’ll have an experienced, collaborative team behind you every step of the way.
 What You’ll Do 
- Build lasting relationships. You’ll earn clients’ trust with a consultative, client-first approach that keeps them with you for years.
- Design custom strategies. You’ll dig into each client’s goals and create personalized plans covering retirement, investments, insurance, and estate planning.
- Educate and empower. You’ll break down complex topics so clients can make confident, informed decisions.
- Bring in the experts. You’ll partner with internal specialists, CPAs, and other professionals to deliver holistic solutions.
- Grow your book. You’ll expand your client base through networking, referrals, and marketing, with our support behind you.
- Stay sharp. You’ll keep up with market trends, new products, and evolving planning strategies so your clients stay ahead.
 Requirements 
 Who Thrives Here 
- You think like an entrepreneur and want to build something of your own
- People enjoy talking to you, and you’re good at earning trust
- You want a career and a business you own, not just a paycheck
- You set goals and push yourself to hit them without someone looking over your shoulder
- You’re curious about money: how it grows, how it’s protected, and how it changes lives
- Sales, finance, or client-service experience helps, but hunger and coachability matter more
 Who You’ll Help 
 Your clients will include:
- Individuals and families building security and planning for the future
- Business owners protecting what they’ve built and planning their next move
- Institutions and organizations that need a trusted financial partner
 Why WealthBridge? 
- No ceiling. Your growth is tied to your effort, not to a salary band or a seniority list.
- Real mentorship. You’ll learn from experienced leaders who want you to win.
- A team culture. We collaborate, share what works, and celebrate each other’s success.
- Meaningful work. You’ll help people make some of the biggest financial decisions of their lives with clarity and confidence.
- A firm built on people. Impact and outcomes come first, for our clients and for our agents.
 Benefits 
 What Sets Us Apart 
- You’re never on your own. You’ll work alongside a network of experienced professionals and mentors, and you’ll have consultants through Integrated Wealth Resources to help with complex client cases.
- Tools that do the heavy lifting. We provide advanced planning resources, digital marketing support, and business development systems so you can focus on clients.
- Your career, your way. The path is flexible and built for entrepreneurs, so you can grow at your own pace and shape what you build.
- We invest in you from day one. That includes licensing support, ongoing training, and continued professional development as you advance.
- Modern technology. Our platforms streamline client engagement and planning, so you spend less time on paperwork and more time making an impact.
- Integrity comes first. Our culture is built on doing right by clients, embracing innovation, and earning trust over the long term.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Business Analyst (Data & Process Transformation) based in Mexico.
We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst to drive data and process transformation initiatives within a complex logistics environment. In this role, you will work at the intersection of business operations, data management, architecture, and software development to improve critical steering, billing, and financial processes. You will analyze complex data flows, translate business requirements into structured technical specifications, and identify opportunities to enhance transparency, efficiency, and operational performance. Working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams, you will support the design, testing, and implementation of sustainable solutions. This position offers the opportunity to influence business-critical processes, strengthen data-driven decision-making, and contribute to long-term operational improvements.


Accountabilities:
Lead business analysis activities across data and process transformation initiatives, ensuring that business requirements are clearly defined, technically actionable, and aligned with operational objectives. Support the evolution of critical cost allocation, billing, and revenue assurance processes through detailed analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and structured implementation.
- 
 Analyze, clarify, and document existing business processes and functional requirements, translating complex needs into structured specifications.
- 
 Conduct advanced data, process, and root-cause analyses to identify inefficiencies, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement.
- 
 Translate business definitions and requirements into new data structures, developing technically feasible calculation rules, determination logic, and processing models.
- 
 Collaborate closely with business departments, enterprise architecture teams, and software development units throughout analysis, solution design, and implementation.
- 
 Define, prepare, and coordinate functional testing and acceptance scenarios to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
- 
 Investigate and assess data discrepancies, process deviations, and unexpected results, providing functional support and contributing to effective resolution strategies.
- 
 Ensure business rules, calculation logic, requirements, and key decisions are accurately documented and traceable.
- 
 Support the introduction of new solutions, including implementation activities, stakeholder coordination, and transition into operational environments.
- 
 Contribute to the continuous development of data-driven controlling and billing processes, particularly in cost and performance accounting and revenue assurance.
- 
 Identify opportunities to improve data quality, process transparency, operational efficiency, and the reliability of business-critical information.
- 
 Facilitate communication between business and technical stakeholders to ensure shared understanding and successful delivery of transformation initiatives.
 Requirements :
 The ideal candidate brings substantial experience in business analysis, requirements engineering, or a comparable role, combined with strong expertise in data models, data flows, and process optimization. You are analytically minded, comfortable working across business and technical environments, and capable of translating complex requirements into practical solutions. You demonstrate a pragmatic, collaborative approach, take ownership of your work, and communicate effectively with stakeholders at different organizational levels.
- 
 At least five years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer, or in a similar position.
- 
 Strong knowledge of data models, data flows, and data-driven business processes.
- 
 Proven analytical capabilities and experience gathering, evaluating, structuring, and documenting complex business requirements.
- 
 Demonstrated experience working at the intersection of business operations, enterprise architecture, and software development.
- 
 Good SQL skills, with the ability to independently perform data analysis and investigate complex datasets.
- 
 Experience translating business requirements into functional specifications, technical implementation logic, and calculation rules.
- 
 Familiarity with AWS and/or PL/SQL is considered an advantage.
-

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.




THE ROLE

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

 - Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

 - Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

 - Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

 - Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

 - Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

 - Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR  

 - Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

 - Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

 - Comfortable working across different business functions.

 - Strong ownership and execution skills.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 - Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

 - Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - People who only want to attend meetings.  

 - Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.  

 - Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.  

 - People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.  

 - People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions



LOCATION 

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in United States. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in United States.



LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.



INTERVIEW PROCESS:

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task 

 2. Role-specific interview 

 3. CEO / final round 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. 

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

 · Support data models and dashboards and coordinate with technical personnel to resolve reporting and data issues.
 · Translate business and product requirements into clear technical specifications for the team.
 · Document business requirements, processes, procedures, meeting notes, and newly discovered requirements in Confluence, keeping the team's knowledge repository current and preventing knowledge silos.
 · Work in an Agile Scrum execution team to ensure all contract deliverables, program milestones, and reporting requirements are met in support of program objectives.
 · Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
 · Perform other duties as assigned.
 SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 None.
 Requirements

 · Must be able to meet and maintain eligibility requirements for a Public Trust position in accordance with Department of Commerce and OPM requirements. U.S. work authorization is required.
 · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Master’s preferred.
 · Seven (7) or more years of software-development experience across frontend and backend technologies.
 · Demonstrated experience in requirements management and requirements traceability.
 · Strong analytical and documentation skills, with experience using requirements management tools.
 · Experience working in Agile environments.
 · Experience in system design or technical integration for large complex IT programs.
 · Experience producing SOPs and technical documentation.
 DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

 WORK SCHEDULE 
 Full-time. May be required to work additional hours as needed to complete assignment or project.

Driving, with or without accommodation, may be required when traveling for training and/or short occasional amounts of local driving. The expected driving time is less than 15%.

 PHYSICAL DEMANDS

 Compensation & Benefits:

- Eligible Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & AD&D Insurance, Long-Term & Short-Term Disability Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Vacation & Paid Personal Time, 11 Paid Federal Holidays, and Leave of Absence.

 We are looking for a Product, Business Analyst who brings expertise in business requirements, process documentation, stakeholder facilitation, and platform implementation support. This role serves as a critical bridge between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and product leadership, translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements and supporting the successful delivery of platform enhancements and implementations.  
 This is a cross-functional role suited for someone who thrives in varied technical and business environments, brings structure to ambiguity, and is comfortable working across discovery, documentation, validation, and implementation readiness. At its core, the role is about thinking through how each capability should work, defining the business rules, logic, edge cases, and dependencies that turn product vision into clear, build-ready requirements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to ensure that stakeholder needs are clearly understood, documented, and carried through to delivery.  
   Key Responsibilities   
 Requirements Gathering & Documentation   
  Attend discovery sessions with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements for platform implementations, enhancements, and operational workflows.  
- Translate complex business needs into clear user stories, process flows, use cases, business rules, and BRD/FRD documentation, working with Product Owners to define how the application should behave across primary paths and edge cases.  
- Maintain a living requirements repository with traceability from business need through requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, validation, and delivered solution.  
- Identify gaps between current platform capabilities and business requirements and work with Product Owner to document well-reasoned options for stakeholder review.  
- Attend workshops, walkthroughs, and validation sessions to confirm scope, business rules, workflows, and expected outcomes.  
- Work with the platform team to document workflows, configurations, dependencies, data inputs and outputs, and system behaviors as they evolve.  
- Ensure requirements are clear, complete, testable, and aligned to approved objectives before they enter delivery.  
- Work with Product Owner to create and maintain tickets, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria based on approved priorities.  
 Backlog & Delivery Support   
- Prepare stories and tickets for refinement by ensuring each carries sufficient business context, requirements detail, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.  
- Clarify open questions and resolve requirements ambiguity for product and engineering teams throughout delivery.  
- Track requirement changes, assumptions, risks, and dependencies across the delivery lifecycle, and surface open decisions and recommendations for resolution.  
- Identify recurring stakeholder pain points, process gaps, and documentation needs, and share them as structured inputs to inform roadmap and prioritization decisions.  
   Platform Implementation Support   
- Document current-state and future-state workflows, business rules, configuration needs, and stakeholder impacts.  
- Support configuration discussions by documenting requirements for fields, workflows, permissions, reporting, and data dependencies.  
- Develop training materials, process documentation, onboarding guides, and SOPs to support platform adoption and ongoing use.  
- Surface risks, blockers, and unresolved questions early, and help coordinate resolution across stakeholders, product, and delivery teams.

title: Deployment Strategist - Financial Services
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Pilots don't train with real passengers. Actors don't rehearse with real audiences. Yet, the most consequential decisions in society are often pushed straight to production.

 

Simile is changing that. We have built the first AI simulation of society, populated by generative agents based on real humans. Our research pioneered the field of AI-based simulation, proving it is possible to model human behavior with high accuracy. Today, we are developing a Foundation Model to predict human behavior in any situation, at any scale.

 

We have raised $300M in total funding, with a $2B post-money valuation in our latest round. Our investors include Greenoaks, Index Ventures, Hanabi, A*, Bain Capital Ventures, Factory, CVS Health Ventures, and Definition.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Deployment Strategist at Simile means making sure simulation is deeply valuable to our customers. You’ll get to know their business well enough to see where simulation can change a decision, then help them turn those problems into simulations. You'll take what you learn back to our product and research teams to collaborate on what we build next.

 

The people who do well here are energized by customers and their experience in the product: building relationships, digging into hard problems, and staying on top of the details. You'll move fast, have real ownership early, and work closely with product and research on problems that matter to Fortune 500 organizations across industries.

 

We work with customers across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, pharma, retail, CPG, financial services and entertainment. Depending on your past experience, your interests and the team’s needs, you may work with one customer or several, in one vertical or across a few. We’ll talk through this with you during your interviews.

 


IDEALLY, YOU'D HAVE:

Experience from one of three areas:

 1. Operators coming from companies that deploy enterprise AI or data products

 2. Strategy consultants or investors who want to move into tech to own outcomes

 3. PMs or engineers who got pulled into the business and customer side and never looked back

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Own your Customers: Be the person your customers rely on - responsive, on top of the details, and trusted to get things done

 - Drive Deployments: Own enterprise customer engagements from first call to full deployment and beyond

 - Know the Product: Go deep on Simile's platform - simulations, population modeling, evals, and validations - and bring that knowledge into every customer conversation

 - Work Cross-functionally: Bridge the gap between what customers need and what product and modeling teams build, and make sure the right insights from the field shape internal decisions

 - Shape the Business: Take on high-impact projects that span the full business - from how we land new customers to how we think about simulation quality and what we build next

 


REQUIREMENTS


MUST HAVES

 - Mindset: Thrives in ambiguous, 0-1 environments - scrappy, resourceful, and doesn't wait to be told what to do

 - Reliability: The person your teammates and customers can count on - detail-oriented, accountable, and consistent

 - Customer Focus: Exceptional communicator who builds trust quickly with senior stakeholders and knows how to navigate complex relationships

 - Product Fluency: Able to get up to speed on technical concepts quickly and explain them clearly; no coding required, but comfortable engaging with AI concepts like evals, validation, and model behavior

 - Travel: Willing to travel for customer engagements

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Comfort building lightweight tools or automations (scripts, no-code tools, etc.)

 - Familiarity with enterprise software deployments or B2B SaaS

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Simile, we provide competitive compensation packages that include base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

 - Salary Range: $150,000 – $300,000 USD
   
   - Note: Final offers are based on experience, specialized skills, interview performance, and relevant training.

 - Equity: Grants are available for eligible roles, subject to board approval.

 - Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Time Off: Flexible time off policies to support work-life balance.

 


OUR PROCESS

We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring journey is designed to help both sides align on fit, working style, and expectations.

 

Reapplication Policy: To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Simile observes a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role.

 


COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Equal Opportunity: Simile is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities, valuing an environment where everyone can contribute authentically.

 

Accommodations: If you require support or reasonable accommodations during the application process due to a disability, please let us know. We are happy to assist.

PDT Partners – a quantitative investment manager – is looking for a n analytical, curious, and tenacious Financ e Associate to join our Finance, Accounting , and Treasury (“FACT”) team. Unlike traditional finance roles, this position offers the opportunity to modernize our operations across treasury, finance, ta x , a nd reporting . This role focuses on deeply understanding the "why" behind our processes, identifying opportunities for improvement , implementing efficiency gains, and harnessing data to drive better decision-making across the firm. 
 As a Finance Associate, you will cross train in various FACT responsibilities to develop expertise in multiple domains. You will collaborate closely with operational and technical teams across the company, contribute to day-to-day operations, and brainstorm with other groups within PDT on implementing trading strategies. In this role, you'll be a core member of the FACT team—integral to running our business and building the infrastructure that enables our growth. 
 This is a hybrid position and will require the person to work from our New York City office at minimum 3 days a week. 
 Why join us?    
 PDT Partners has a 30+ year track record and a reputation for excellence. Our goal is to be the best quantitative investment manager in the world—measured by the quality of our products, not their size. PDT’s very high employee-retention rate speaks for itself. Our people are intellectually extraordinary and our community is close-knit, down-to-earth, and diverse.  
 Responsibilities:    
- Develop broad expertise by rotating across treasury, finance, fund reporting, and tax compliance 
- Support day-to-day FACT operations, e.g. cash management, margin analysis, tax estimates, compliance reporting, and counterparty management 
- Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and implement solutions by collaborating with internal operations development teams and leveraging data systems and AI tools 
- Liaise with external service providers, such as prime brokers and accounting firms 
- Lead or contribute to special projects and ad-hoc analyses both within the FACT team and across the firm   
 Below is a list of skills and experiences we think are relevant. Even if you don’t think you’re a perfect match, we still encourage you to apply because we are committed to developing our people .   
- 2-4 years of professional experience in Finance, Treasury, Data Science, Management Information Systems, Accounting and Tax, or related fields   
- Basic programming skills or experience with AI-assisted tools to automate and streamline workflows 
- Strong analytical and quantitative skills
- Intellectual curiosity: eager to learn about our business and understand the "why" behind processes
- Diligence: a demonstrated ability to be meticulous and thorough in delivering high-quality work
- Tenacity: enthusiastic about taking on new challenges and determined to get the job done
- Self-motivation: driven to deliver excellent work and identify improvement opportunities
- Clear communication: ability to speak and write in a clear and concise manner
- Strong teamwork: collaborate and work effectively across teams   
 The salary range for this role is between $120,000 and $150,000.   This range is not inclusive of any potential bonus amounts.   Factors that may impact the agreed upon salary within the range for a particular candidate include years of experience, level of education obtained, skill set, and other external factors.  
 PRIVACY STATEMENT: For information on ways PDT may collect, use, and process your personal information, please see   PDT’s privacy notices .

 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 You Belong Here 
 The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver. 
 At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success.  Where We Need You

 As a Senior Consultant, you will be a mentor, trainer, and coach to Interns and Consultants as you facilitate the successful completion of project work plans. You'll identify areas of risk and opportunities to increase efficiency. You'll strengthen relationships and deepen your abilities to communicate, gain trust, and network with client personnel and professional associates.  What Will Help You Be Successful

- You are motivated to learn and interested in all things related to AI adoption and activation, workforce readiness, organization and job design, human-agent workflow redesign, learning and capability building, and value realization, including the latest trends and developments.

- You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing clients with exceptional experiences. 
- You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership. 
- You contribute to a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members. 
- You create development opportunities for others and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities. 
- You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries. 
 Do Your Talents Include the Following? 
- Experience with or understanding of: 
- Conducting workforce readiness assessments, stakeholder analyses, and adoption diagnostics to support enterprise AI adoption from pilot through scale. 
- Designing and executing activation campaigns, adoption roadmaps, and champion/super-user networks that drive proficiency, utilization, and sustained behavior change. 
- Developing role-based learning journeys, AI Academy content, manager enablement toolkits, and learning-in-the-flow-of-work experiences. 
- Supporting the design of future-state organizations enabled by AI and human intelligence (AI + HI), including team composition, spans of control, and supervisory models. 
- Assisting in defining new roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and accountability models impacted by AI-enabled workflows.

title: Banking and Financial Institutions Lead
description:
ABOUT OPEN STANDARD

Open Standard is on a mission to build the world's best money, starting with the US dollar. We believe money should move the way data does: instantly, globally, at any hour, in any amount.

Our flagship product, Open USD (OUSD) https://ousd.xyz/, is a stablecoin built for the internet. It's live on Ethereum, Base, Solana, and Tempo, with Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe, and Visa as founding partners and 200+ companies in our network.

We're a lean team in San Francisco and New York, led by Zach Abrams, who co-founded Bridge and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring our Banking and Financial Institutions Lead: the person who brings OUSD to banks, asset managers, exchanges and the rest of traditional finance.

This is a sales role, and a long-term bet. Our model should change how dollars move through the financial system, and that change runs through institutions that move carefully. You'll plug OUSD into flows that either don't exist yet or that we're replacing, which means long, education-heavy cycles with many counterparties at the table.

You'll own a large surface area of banks and capital markets firms, mostly on your own from day one. That means daily meetings with institutions, learning fast what works and what doesn't, and seeing complex deals through to signature.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own OS's relationships with banks, asset managers, exchanges, and capital markets players.

 - Build and run a pipeline of institutional deals from first meeting to signed agreement.

 - Represent Open Standard with senior leaders at large financial institutions.

 - Map every deal's counterparties (business sponsors, risk, compliance, legal, treasury, operations, technology) and get each of them to yes.

 - Shape use cases with partners, such as stablecoin settlement, collateral, and treasury flows, and turn them into a clear value proposition.

 - Educate institutions on stablecoins and OUSD, and turn their objections into product and policy feedback for the team.

 - Work closely with our capital markets, partnerships, policy, and product teams.

 - Help define how we sell to TradFi as the team grows.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 7 to 15 years selling to banks and other financial institutions, with a track record of closing large, complex deals.

 - You know how banks buy: who signs, who can block, how risk and compliance reviews work, and how long it really takes.

 - Fluent in institutional and trading-focused clients, and in the language of Wall Street and TradFi.

 - A strong network across banks and capital markets, and the credibility to get a meeting with senior decision makers.

 - Experience with stablecoins, digital assets, or payments infrastructure.

 - Polished in the room, scrappy outside it. You drive deals forward even when the other side moves slowly.

 - Comfortable working with a high degree of independence and no existing playbook.

 - Low ego, high ownership, and direct.

 - Already using AI tools in how you research, prepare, and sell.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a stablecoin issuer, digital asset custodian, or crypto infrastructure company selling to banks.

 - Time inside a bank or broker-dealer, in addition to selling to them.

 - Knowledge of settlement, collateral, and market structure at exchanges and clearinghouses.

 - Familiarity with the US regulatory landscape for stablecoins and bank activities.

title: Economist, Macro & Economic Insights
location: San Francisco HQ; New York City Office
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.



The Economics Team uses economic research and data science to deepen our understanding of economic, credit, and financial trends. We combine rigorous empirical analysis with clear communication to inform decisions across and beyond Plaid.



You will conduct applied economic research, develop reliable analytical methods, and turn complex findings into clear, useful insights. Working with economists and data scientists, you will own research projects from question framing and data preparation through validation and written communication. This is a hands-on role for an economist who enjoys working with large datasets, exercising sound judgment, and explaining evidence and limitations to a range of audiences. You will have opportunities to develop a research specialty and take on broader ownership as the team grows.



We're guided by our principles including impact, growing together, embracing openness and positivity, and inventing tomorrow; we're looking for leaders who are motivated by those same principles






Responsibilities

 - Investigating economic questions and trends through rigorous empirical research, from framing the question through analysis, validation, and communication

 - Working with large, complex datasets to develop reliable measures and reproducible analytical workflows

 - Evaluating findings against established research and public benchmarks, assessing data quality and representativeness, and clearly communicating uncertainty and limitations

 - Applying econometric and time-series methods to test hypotheses, assess robustness, and distinguish meaningful patterns from noise

 - Writing clear research briefs and presenting findings to technical and nontechnical audiences; partnering with colleagues across research, data science, and the business to identify useful questions and inform decisions






Qualifications

 - PhD in economics or a related empirical field, or a Master's plus 4+ years of relevant applied experience, with strong empirical training. Exceptional candidates completing their PhD in 2027 are welcome; relevant research includes applied macroeconomics, household or behavioral finance, fintech, and financial regulation

 - Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience independently analyzing large, complex datasets and building reproducible analytical workflows

 - Strong econometric and time-series modeling skills, with experience applying these methods to economic questions and assessing robustness

 - Excellent writing for non-academic audiences, demonstrated through policy memos, market commentary, or research briefs. You can explain and defend your methods, findings, and limitations to technical and nontechnical audiences

 - Sound research judgment: you distinguish evidence from interpretation, communicate uncertainty, and scope claims to what the data supports

 - Nice to have: experience conducting applied economic research in fintech, finance, a research institute, or a public-sector organization; prior ownership of a recurring research publication

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!



Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.



Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here https://plaid.com/legal/#candidate-privacy-notice.


Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. description:
Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about supporting professional growth and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages.
 CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. Travel is reasonable and your work/life balance will benefit as a result. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a midsized CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most with support from direct line management.
 To support continued growth from our clients, we are hiring all levels of CRAs experienced in monitoring Oncology, Cardiology, or Lupus,
 Position Summary: 
 The CRA II is a seasoned, experienced professional in monitoring and site management. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the CRA II is assigned and typically include activities involving start-up and study implementation, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management. Incumbents work independently as a study team member.
 Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to: 
- Oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports.
- Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
- Updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports.
- If required, manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager.
- If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee.
- Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
- Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/ qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote).
- Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
- Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
- Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues.
- Develops and maintains good working relationship with investigators and study staff, serving as an ambassador to promote Precision high quality and professional image.
 [...] - Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies.
 [...] - Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face-to-face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
 [...]  Qualifications: 
 Minimum Required: 
- 4-year college degree or equivalent experience in a scientific or healthcare discipline. 
- Two (2) years or more as a CRA in a CRO or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies. Site management or equivalent experience 
in clinical research
 Other Required: 
- Excellent communication and organizational skills are essential. A team player.
- Evidence of a client focused approach
- Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail.
- Ability to travel overnight. Up to 60% travel on average, based on regional requirements. International travel as needed.
- Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where position based
 Preferred: 
- Graduate or postgraduate degree
- Lupus monitoring experience
- Experience monitoring in rare and complex therapeutic areas
- Experience monitoring EDC trials and EHR records
- Experience in biopharma or relevant therapeutic area
- Relevant site start-up (feasibility, contract negotiations, submissions) experience for the particular country
- Ability to monitor study sites, with supervision, according to protocol monitoring guidelines, SOPs, GCP and ICH guidelines.
 [...]

description:
About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Available Locations: Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City 
 About the Team
 Our team researches web application attacks and turns that research into protections in Cloudflare’s Web Application Firewall (WAF). We build and maintain managed rules that help protect millions of Internet properties from known vulnerabilities, emerging exploits, and new attack techniques.
 We work at the intersection of vulnerability research, large-scale traffic analysis, and detection engineering. Using threat intelligence and telemetry from Cloudflare’s global network, we identify exploitation patterns, develop mitigations, and measure how well they work against real traffic. We partner with Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams to improve coverage while minimizing false positives and disruption to legitimate applications.
 Who You Are
- You have hands-on experience in web application security, vulnerability research, or detection engineering, including writing and improving WAF rules, exploit signatures, or comparable detection logic.
- You understand HTTP/HTTPS, how web applications and proxies process requests, and common vulnerability classes such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, remote code execution, SSRF, and insecure deserialization.
- You can analyze a vulnerability advisory or proof of concept, reproduce the exploit in a controlled environment, and identify the request characteristics that distinguish exploitation from legitimate traffic.
- You use SQL to investigate large datasets and a language such as Python, Go, or Rust to build research tools, automate analysis, and validate detections.
- You make evidence-based tradeoffs between detection coverage, false positives, and performance. You are comfortable investigating ambiguous reports and following issues through to resolution.
- You work effectively with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing teams, and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- You use AI fluently in research and coding workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where its outputs need independent validation.
- You are curious about how attackers exploit web applications and bypass defenses. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.
 What You'll Do
 We are looking for a Security Research Analyst to research web application threats and develop the managed rules that protect Cloudflare customers. You will turn public CVEs, threat intelligence, customer reports, and internal telemetry into tested, effective mitigations.

description:
CancerNavigator is an early-stage healthcare company (remote, headquartered in Washington, D.C.) dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.  
 Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief 
 Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.
 CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. All of our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who work with members to catch cancer early, get them to fantastic experts for their care, and help them through the thousands of other problems patients and their families face.
 Join us to help serve cancer patients in their hour of need.
 The “Research Associate” Role 
 The number one priority of a research associate is to produce high-quality research that will help patients understand crucial information in their hour of need. Research Associates support the following efforts:
- Creating Custom Documents for Patients: The Patient Service Team’s mandate is to help cancer patients make decisions in this difficult hour of need, and our mechanism for serving patients is education. The primary responsibility for a researcher on our team is to create excellent tailored documents for patients, and to collaborate with our oncology nurse navigators to teach each patient what they need to know about their specific situation. This is an “on-demand” function – when patients need help, our entire team jumps into action.
- Enhancing Our Research Base: Our team has spent over five years building a deep research foundation on nearly every cancer type and subtype, which we use to inform the education and guidance we deliver to patients. The cancer landscape is continually evolving, and our research base requires updating regularly to reflect changes in diagnostics, treatment protocols, techniques, and more. A central function of a research associate is to assist in the enhancement of our core research base by identifying gaps in our research as we serve patients, and occasionally performing research “deep dives” to fill in those gaps.
 The Requirements 
 The right person for this role would be eager to jump in immediately and begin mastering the clinical content. More specifically, we are looking for someone with:
- 1-2 years of professional research experience on clinical topics 
- Experience reading and examining academic literature on medical subjects 
- Ability to quickly master complex clinical content in both depth and breadth
- Ability to execute research projects autonomously
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
 Preferred Qualifications 
- Masters degree requiring research in a related field
- Willingness to work MST hours
 Compensation and Benefits 
- Salary Range: $71k-76k (dependent on qualifications and experience)
- Remote-first work; live where you want within the continental U.S.
- All-company on-sites 2-3 times per year in Washington D.C. (HQ) or other locations
- Medical and Dental Insurance (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)
- Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
- Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy-up coverage)
- Unlimited PTO
 Our Culture & Values, In Brief 
 We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.
 We have three company values, which guide our company: 
- Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.
- Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.
- Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.
